preview: Today’s episode looks at what happens when AI is used in hiring, before a person may see a job application. Why does this matter for a fair chance at work, and who must explain a decision when software helps shape it?
comment_1: As you listen, notice how one event is seen from different viewpoints.
comment_2: Now, you will hear three different voices, one after another. Each person will share their own view on what you just heard.
comment_3: You have heard three different ways of experiencing the same situation. Instead of deciding which view is right, let us ask why the situation feels different to each person. Next, we will look more closely at where that difference comes from.
comment_4: So the question is not only who is right. We can also ask what makes this situation work the way it does.
